cards.title: Why it works
items: The roster is declared by an echo before any lane runs — the master list is data, not model memory
Every lane transforms a single roster item; the auditor reconciles results against the roster, so silent loss fails loud
Teaches the fan-out surfaces: declared items, per-item payload, and roster-vs-result coverage
